connections.why: Fraction, decimal and percentage work relies on secure calculation
Standard form and bounds extend core number skills
Algebra generalises the laws of arithmetic and indices
Percentages and fractions are the language of proportion
Rearranging expressions is the skill that solves equations
Equations of lines and curves are drawn as graphs
Solutions of equations are the points where graphs meet
Sequences are described by algebraic nth-term rules
Rates such as speed and density are proportional relationships
Gradients of graphs represent rates of change
Knowing shape properties is needed to calculate their measures
Pythagoras and trigonometry rest on accurate calculation
Similar shapes and scale use ratio and proportion
Vectors describe translations and geometric relationships
Probabilities are expressed as fractions, decimals and percentages
Proportion underpins sampling and comparing data sets
Relative frequency links observed data to probability
Statistical diagrams build on graphing and coordinate skills
